label: s1_sub_007_woman_01
text: Ooohohoho! Ooohohoho![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_007_woman_02
text: Look, Billy! Look at this puddle![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_007_man_01
text: This is no puddle, my dearest O’Nare! This is the\nfamed Casseroya Lake—the largest lake in Paldea![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_007_woman_03
text: Y-you’re telling me this is a lake?! Surely it can’t\nbe more than a pond![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_007_woman_04
text: Say, Billy—what’s the difference between a lake\nand a pond, anyway?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_007_man_02
text: I’m not sure, dearest O’Nare... We Glitterati\ndon’t tend to clutter our heads with such trivial\r\ncommon knowledge...[VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_007_woman_05
text: Hm...? Why, it’s the commoner we always see\naround![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_007_man_03
text: You’re right! Your eyes do not deceive you—\nit’s the commoner we always see around![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_007_woman_06
text: While we have you, dear commoner, do tell...\nWhat exactly is the difference between a pond\r\nand a lake?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_007_select_01
text: Their size?

label: s1_sub_007_select_02
text: Their depth?

label: s1_sub_007_woman_07
text: Ah, of course! Most impressive! You’re as well-\nversed in common knowledge as I’d hoped![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_007_woman_08
text: It’s our duty as Glitterati to return the kindness\nwe are given...[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_007_woman_09
text: Or more specifically, to return that kindness with\nfine items.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_007_woman_10
text: Now, do pay attention, dear commoner...\nHappiness is like a body of water.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_007_woman_11
text: It can be a puddle, a pond, or even a lake. It all\ndepends on how you think about it.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_007_man_04
text: That’s my dearest O’Nare! Taking the knowledge\nsomeone just taught you and putting it on display\r\nright in front of them![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_007_woman_12
text: Come now, Billy! I’d like to scale [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]a lofty mountain[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]with pure, white snow[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]—as pure and lofty as the\r\nideals of our company![VAR 0x0114(0041)]

label: s1_sub_007_man_05
text: Pfwee! It’s true that Paldea Realty has the purest,\nloftiest ideals! Dearest O’Nare, you truly are an\r\nexemplary Glitterati![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_007_man_06
text: Now, let’s go enjoy some gelato while watching\nice Pokémon frolic atop a snowy mountain![VAR 0x0114(0040)]

label: s1_sub_007_secretary_01
text: Mr. Billy and Lady O’Nare have gone off to a\nlarge body of water in Paldea...

label: s1_sub_007_secretary_02
text: What could that mean, “a large body of water”?\nA river? A pond? Or maybe even a lake...?
